review.summary: The artifact references several modules and services that are not currently grounded in the system_state.json, which could lead to ungrounded assumptions. Additionally, there are no explicit validation steps for the proposed changes.

findings.title: Un-grounded module references
findings.evidence: The artifact mentions `AppLayout`, `AdminNavigationMenu`, and other components that are not listed in system_state.json under modules or service_modules.
findings.requiredAction: Ensure all referenced modules and services exist in the system_state.json before proceeding.

findings.title: Missing validation steps
findings.evidence: The artifact lacks explicit validation steps for the proposed changes, such as route inventory generation and schema-to-IA reconciliation.
findings.requiredAction: Add concrete validation steps and executable checks before claiming completion.
